mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 71 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School under a waning crescent moon.

The Verona Fire Department is inviting the community to an open house on September 19 between 10 AM and 2 PM. Located at 101 Lincoln Street, the event features tours of the facility, meetings with firefighters, and various safety activities for everyone to enjoy.

It is a busy day in Verona today. Events include live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Brewing hosts trivia tomorrow.

Regarding the weekly police report, an investigation was opened following a report on Sunday, August 30, concerning an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently closed for the morning but will open today at 10:00 AM.
